verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox publicly lists a starting price ('Plans from $9.99 per month') and advertises free unlimited online storage. Check deposit is offered only at select locations, with no fee shown. Nothing in the evidence shows scan allowances or per-item fees, so the pricing is not shown to be complete. Missing for 10: per-plan scan allowances, per-item fees for extra scans, forwarding, physical storage, and check deposit, and a full public plan comparison or pricing table.
